proposals.title: Files dragged by a hand into a prompt box, landing as captioned attachment chips
proposals.why: 8.6 s at 2142×1080. Per file: a closed hand carries the icon along a curve from off-screen bottom right (1.97 s), the icon shrinks into a chip, the hand opens and fades, and the filename appears 65 px below. Files stagger 2.4667 s apart, landing 175 px apart. Note: the path expressions currently fail in EffectCraft, so the reference GIF shows no travel (see breakdown).
proposals.call: dragDropAttach(comp, {at, box: footage, files: [{icon, name}], step: 2.4667, spacing: 175, from: [x, y], travel: 1.9667})
proposals.overlaps: uses darkStage and the parts below; cursorClick (proposals.json) covers the cursor idea

proposals.title: Carry layers along a curved path, turning to follow it
proposals.why: A null follows a bezier path by a progress slider (100→0 over 1.97 s, out infl 34.7, in 96.7: fast launch, long glide) and turns to the path's direction (about 55° at the start, −3.77° at landing). Children are counter-rotated (+3.77°) so they land upright.
proposals.call: pathCarry(layers, {from: [x, y], to: [x, y], bend, at, duration: 1.9667, orient: true})
proposals.overlaps: cursorClick (travels to a target; this adds a real curve and auto-orient). Could be its `drag` option

proposals.title: Closed hand opens and lets go
proposals.why: On the drop frame the closed-hand art swaps to the open hand, which grows 24→38.3 % (0.17 s, in infl 100), tilts +3.77°→−3.73° (0.27 s) and fades 100→0 (2.13–2.4 s, even ease). It reads as letting go.
proposals.overlaps: cursorClick (press dip); this is the drag-and-release version

proposals.title: Dragged item shrinks into a slot and settles
proposals.why: Icon scale 16→6.8 % over 0.27 s (ease in: out infl 100, in 33.3), then a swapped copy settles 6.8→8.3 % in 0.1 s. A file becoming a small attachment chip.
proposals.overlaps: pop (rebound on entry); this is a shrink with a rebound up

proposals.title: Filename caption pinned under an icon
proposals.why: Arial 18, #d9dee3, centred text whose position expression is the icon's centre + [0, 65], so it follows the icon. Appears on the drop frame.

proposals.title: UI screenshot keyed and masked onto the stage
proposals.why: The prompt-box screenshot's own background is colour-keyed out (key #111519, tolerance 10.7) and a 15-point mask with 19 px feather trims it, so a real app UI sits cleanly on the slate stage.

proposals.title: Near-black radial stage behind a scene
proposals.why: drag-drop: slate Radial Ramp #171919 at [960, 381] (centre raised behind the box) → #0e1214 at [960, 1080], on a 1920×1080 solid scaled 284 %.
